product.olivetti-m380.summary: Sixteen-megahertz 80386DX desktop family with proprietary Olivetti logic, external controllers and local 1.09 firmware.
product.olivetti-m380.history: The M380 (BA806) and the compact M380 C (BA818) share the documented 16 MHz 80386DX platform. The M380 C NEW adds the GO723 and GO470/481 VGA options; BluMach does not quietly replace them with generic devices.
product.olivetti-m380.warning: PARTIAL EMULATION: POST, video, floppy boot, RTC, the keyboard-controller NVRAM and installing and booting MS-DOS 3.30a from a disk on the GO717 are recorded as passing. Warm reset is still pending. The GO717 is emulated with the WD1003 without its jumpers; PVGA1A, floppy and AT services are compatibility approximations, not models of the backplane or the IF614.
product.olivetti-m380.creation.model: M380 16 MHz 80386DX reference profile: 4 MB, external PVGA1A and one 1.44 MB 3.5-inch floppy drive
product.olivetti-m380.creation.note: M380 and M380 C share the selectable platform. The optional hard disk uses the GO717 with a drive from its table. This BIOS has no Setup in ROM. The M380 user disk has not been recovered, but the SETUP program on the M280 System Test 2.02 disk works on it and stores the drive type in the keyboard-controller NVRAM. M380 C NEW stays disabled because the GO470/481 video is missing.
product.olivetti-m380.technical.commerci: M380 is the BA806 desktop and M380 C the BA818 compact model. The documented M380 C NEW adds GO723 storage/floppy and GO470/481 VGA. This is an options matrix from the service guide, not a recovered price list.
product.olivetti-m380.technical.cpu: Intel 80386DX at 16 MHz with proprietary BA806/BA818 PAL logic; this is not the Headland PCS 386SX platform.
product.olivetti-m380.technical.memory: Memory is entirely on expansion boards: ME908/ME916/ME919 are 1 MB, ME912/ME927 4 MB and ME923 16 MB. The 384 KB behind the hole between 640 KB and 1 MB is dedicated memory: the BIOS looks for it at the 32-bit address 800A0000h and adds it to the total when present. Its top 128 KB shadows E0000h-FFFFFh, which register 2 of the keyboard controller switches between RAM and ROM. With 4 MB, POST shows 640 KB base, 3072 KB extended and 384 KB dedicated: 4096 KB. BluMach reproduces the dedicated memory and the shadow; the rest of the board and backplane logic is still linear RAM.
product.olivetti-m380.technical.video: M380/M380 C use external EGA or monochrome adapters. M380 C NEW's GO470/481 VGA is documented but unavailable; the selectable PVGA1A is an explicit compatibility approximation.
product.olivetti-m380.technical.storage: M380 and M380 C use external controllers: GO717 (WD1003-WAH, ST506/MFM) or GO720 (WD1005-WAH, ESDI). Creation offers the GO717 with the four drives in its Olivetti table (types 6, 7, 12 and 13); the GO720 is not emulated. The GO723 RLL board with floppy belongs to the M380 C NEW.
product.olivetti-m380.technical.firmware: Local PBUQ/PBUZ 1.09 is a verified 64 KiB byte-interleaved pair. The service guide documents later 1.13 and 1.14 pairs, which are not locally preserved.
product.olivetti-m380.technical.verified: Recorded with local firmware 1.09 and the 4 MB/PVGA1A profile: POST, video, floppy boot, RTC, 4096 KB including dedicated memory, valid NVRAM after saving with the M280 SETUP, and MS-DOS 3.30a booting from a type 7 disk on the GO717 (2026-10-16).
product.olivetti-m380.technical.limitati: Still not modelled: the proprietary board and backplane logic, the IF614 floppy path, the floppy bits of register 0 and the bank-test bit of register 2 of the keyboard controller. Warm reset needs repeating: the GO717 now resets on a soft reset, which used to leave a controller error until a cold reset. LPT1 (378h/IRQ7), LPT2 (278h/IRQ5), COM1 and COM2 are modelled as fixed standard ports per CAP7; Resident Diagnostics still has to be repeated with them. The GO717 is emulated with the WD1003: its jumpers are not modelled and it stays at the primary address 1F0h with IRQ 14. The GO720 ESDI is not emulated. The M380's own Customer/System Test disk is missing.

product.olivetti-m380.creation.storage.n: No hard disk: one 1.44 MB floppy drive
